title: The same Envoy charm action produces an identical null result on a different NPC ('Save it for someone who wasn't already digging in the dark before you were born'), suggesting charm has no listed odds or fail-state, it just silently does nothing against certain characters.
where: The Miners' Hall (Cinderhall) / talk to Old Crick -> 'turn on the charm (as an Envoy)'
